biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
biopsy

## PCA: data in PC coordinates

We keep only the numeric columns, scale them and run a PCA. We then add the original data back with augment(), so we can colour the samples by outcome.

```{r}
library(broom)

pca_fit <- biopsy |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  scale() |>
  prcomp()

pca_fit |>
  augment(biopsy) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1, y = .fittedPC2, colour = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(malignant = "#D55E00", benign = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "Outcome") +
  theme_minimal()

```
